title: Expedition run
blurb: A salvage skipper on a stormy coast: sail from the harbour, strip wrecks, fight raiders, and pay off the boat in five voyages.

title: Story and choices
blurb: One night on the last ferry: four passengers, choices that set flags, and three endings, written as ink scenes.

title: Open-world RPG
blurb: A hamlet in a green valley, in third person: the reeve’s quest against bandits in the woods and a cave, a smith who trades, and a job that finds its own cave.

title: First-person adventure
blurb: A lighthouse at night, in first person: the keeper’s log, a chest with a key, a locked store, and a lamp to light before the ship comes.
